Definition: a Girgashite, one of the native tribes of Canaan
BiblicalUsage: The word Girgâshîy is a Girgashite, one of the peoples of Canaan — a small word, used 7 times; Genesis and Deuteronomy show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: Girgâshîy means a Girgashite, one of the peoples of Canaan, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
